notes: Docs lane updates durable planning, inventory, survey, and handoff files only.
Read-only retainer for the robust edit-surface model; stale broad transition plan is not target guidance.
Admission lane owns backend/TUI authority admission and backend side of evidence joins.
Implementation lane for model.md SurfaceGrant authority carrier; no broad request files.
CLI-facing lane only supplies upstream admission arguments and removes old Grant::new test/helper use; no backend/history edits.
History lane owns typed SurfaceEvidence grant/check evidence shape.
Read-only coordination lane; implementation is split across admission and History lanes.
Parent runtime lane adds typed RuntimeId to Parent role state; no CLI/backend/history edits.
Read-only review lane for edit-surface authority patches.
Read-only map of eval-owned carriers against model.md.
Graph builders/types own graph assembly; no store loading or ploke-eval edits.
Loader lane discovers files and fills RunRecordSet/passive evidence only.
Projection lane renders/derives playback views from loaded graph/store facts.
Records lane owns shared passive DTO boundaries and the TUI tool surfaces they re-export from.
Read-only retainer lane for bounded lookup and orientation questions.
Read-only review lane; reviewers do not own edit surfaces.
Read-only map of ploke-tui as harness/projection, not authority.

design-canonical-tool-transport-home.title: Map canonical passive tool transport ownership options
acceptance: Read-only report identifies current owners, dependency edges, and lowest-drift shared-home option without copying DTOs

docs-refresh-graph-ingestion-staleness.title: Refresh graph-ingestion docs for stale child-plan/run-profile rows
acceptance: Docs identify child-plan and run-profile rows as already typed/loaded/ingested where current code supports it
No source code edits
No legacy compatibility work is introduced

esm-admission-coordinate-policy.title: Wire real coordinate and policy into edit-surface admission
acceptance: Backend/TUI admission constructs authority-bearing grants from real runtime/artifact coordinate and policy identity, not synthetic defaults or prompt/child-plan files.
If a caller lacks coordinate/policy, change the local API in owned files to require it rather than falling back to material-only Grant.
ploke-tui remains harness/projection; eval owns grant/check authority.
Report any required upstream parent/request edit as a blocker with exact file:line evidence, not as an accepted deferral.

esm-backend-pass-checked-grant-evidence.title: Pass checked SurfaceGrant evidence from backend
acceptance: CheckedSurfaceEdit::surface_evidence passes the actual checked coordinate/policy/grant evidence through the History API instead of string-only policy recovery.
Backend checked authority and TUI apply authority remain aligned.
No edits outside backend.rs and edit_surface/tui.rs; if History API is not ready, report exact blocker.

esm-cli-final-admission-integration.title: Finalize CLI edit-surface admission integration
acceptance: Production deterministic TUI path passes real EditSurfaceAdmission using parent runtime id and parent checkout target Artifact identity.
No prompt/request/TUI/child-plan state is used as authority.
edit_surface test filter passes.

esm-cli-supply-edit-admission.title: Supply edit-surface admission at CLI-facing callsites
acceptance: Update cli_facing.rs callsites to pass real EditSurfaceAdmission coordinate and policy into validate_edit_surface_candidate.
Do not synthesize authority from prompt files, child-plan paths, request files, or TUI status; if real runtime/artifact coordinate is unavailable, report blocker with exact file:line.
Remove/replace remaining cli_facing.rs surface::Grant::new helper use with authority-bearing construction if it is a test helper; no material-only Grant.
No edits outside cli_facing.rs.

esm-core-mandatory-surfacegrant.title: Make SurfaceGrant authority mandatory and check-preserving
acceptance: Remove Option<GrantAuthority>; normal Grant/SurfaceGrant must require coordinate and policy authority.
Material-only bounds, if needed for helper logic, must be a distinct non-authority adapter and must not be constructible as Grant.
Check must preserve grant authority/provenance so downstream apply/History can cite it.
Focused tests prove broad/request-style construction cannot mint non-authority Grant, narrow preserves authority, and checked path exposes coordinate/policy.

esm-final-authority-erasure-fix.title: Eliminate final edit-surface authority erasure
acceptance: No optional GrantAuthority, no authority-less Apply construction, checked grants persist coordinate and policy authority with typed RuntimeId, and focused edit_surface tests pass.

esm-history-checked-grant-api.title: Make SurfaceEvidence checked API accept typed grant authority
acceptance: SurfaceEvidence::checked or equivalent takes typed grant/check evidence and no longer hardcodes grant: None for checked edit-surface evidence.
Keep existing History tests typed; update local History tests to construct the named grant/check evidence carrier.
No serde_json::Value, no prompt/child-plan/request-file authority, and no edits outside history.rs.

esm-history-surfacegrant-evidence.title: Persist grant coordinate and policy in surface evidence
acceptance: SurfaceEvidence or its typed sub-records include coordinate/grant/policy evidence as named Rust types, not serde_json::Value or ad hoc projection fields.
Proposal remains intermediate; persisted evidence ties admitted artifact transition to checked SurfaceGrant authority.
History records do not treat prompt path, child plan path, request file, or TUI status as authority.
If history needs backend/check API changes outside this lane, report exact blocker rather than adding lossy compatibility fields.

esm-join-grant-evidence-backend-history.title: Join checked grant authority into History evidence
acceptance: SurfaceEvidence::checked or equivalent accepts typed grant/check evidence derived from the actual checked SurfaceGrant, not policy strings plus grant: None.
CheckedSurfaceEdit::surface_evidence passes original coordinate/policy/grant authority into History using named Rust types.
TUI apply authority and backend checked authority remain aligned; no prompt/child-plan/request-file authority.
No edits outside backend.rs, history.rs, and edit_surface/tui.rs.

esm-map-eval-code.title: Map eval-owned edit-surface code to model.md
acceptance: Return exact file:line ranges for SurfaceGrant/Grant, Proposal/EditProposal, Check/CheckedProposal, ArtifactDelta, SurfaceEvidence, surface_attempt, and OperationCoordinate equivalents.
Identify drift where code treats request/prompt/child-plan files as authority instead of SurfaceGrant+check+History evidence.
No edits; include smallest verification commands.

esm-map-tui-boundary.title: Map ploke-tui harness boundary to model.md
acceptance: Return exact file:line ranges where TUI stages EditProposal, resolves WriteSnippetData, applies edits, and eval lowers/checks TUI evidence.
Separate harness/projection facts from authority facts, using model.md terminology.
No edits; include smallest verification commands.

esm-parent-runtime-id-carrier.title: Carry RuntimeId on Parent role state
acceptance: Parent<S> carries a typed loop_graph::RuntimeId for the running parent Runtime and exposes it through an accessor.
All Parent state transitions preserve runtime_id structurally; tests/helpers construct Parent with runtime_id.
Do not encode runtime identity in ParentIdentity.instance_id or prompt/request files.
No edits outside parent.rs.

esm-retain-model.title: Retain edit-surface model invariants
acceptance: Report the model.md authority chain, lossy reductions to refuse, and 2-6 month structural carriers in <=120 lines.
Explicitly ignore docs/active/agents/2026-05-12_broad-bounded-surface-transition-plan.md as target guidance.

esm-review-authority-chain-final.title: Final review of edit-surface authority chain
acceptance: Review that Grant authority is mandatory, not Optional, and material-only filters are not accepted as SurfaceGrant.
Review that admission uses real coordinate/policy authority or reports exact upstream blockers instead of synthetic fallback.
Review that Check/apply/History preserve coordinate, policy, and grant evidence through named Rust types.
Return findings ordered by severity with exact file:line references and an accept/fix decision; no edits.

esm-review-surfacegrant-coordinate-polic.title: Review SurfaceGrant coordinate/policy patch
acceptance: Review the patch for correctness, semantic alignment with model.md, structural naming, authority/provenance risks, and test adequacy.
No edits; return findings ordered by severity with exact file:line references and recommended accept/fix decision.

esm-surfacegrant-coordinate-policy.title: Bind SurfaceGrant to coordinate and policy
acceptance: Add or strengthen a model-facing SurfaceGrant authority carrier binding coordinate, policy identity, and existing material Grant/Check semantics.
Preserve existing backend/TUI callsites; do not require broad request or child-plan changes in this slice.
Add focused tests in edit_surface/tests.rs proving coordinate target artifact mismatch is rejected and accepted grants expose coordinate/policy.
No edits outside allowed files.

graph-build-ingest-attempt-results.title: Attach attempt-scoped runner results and passive operation source evidence
acceptance: Graph consumes PassiveEvidence::attempt_runner_results from RunRecordSet
Passive invocation/request/result operations carry source evidence or locators
No filesystem discovery or History authority drift in graph build

graph-build-ingest-run-attempts.title: Attach loaded run attempt metadata to Graph evidence
acceptance: Graph consumes PassiveEvidence::run_attempts only from RunRecordSet
No filesystem discovery or deserialization in graph builder
Run attempts attach as evidence/metadata and not History authority

graph-build-membership-selected-scope.title: Remove label-only selected membership fallback in graph selection
acceptance: Graph selection membership resolution does not assign selected membership by label-only fallback
Candidate-set root or recorded candidate identity governs selected membership attachment
No store, records, or ploke-eval edits

graph-build-split-passive-ingestion.title: Split graph builders and attach loaded passive evidence
acceptance: Graph::from_records remains the only assembly entry point
Builder consumes only already-loaded RunRecordSet fields
History ordering remains primary and passive evidence does not become authority

graph-types-organize-core.title: Organize ploke-tree graph domain types around core graph objects
acceptance: Graph remains the central immutable read-side object
Types preserve Artifact, Runtime, Operation, History, and evidence distinctions
No builder or loader behavior changes

playback-fine-module-split.title: Split oversized playback fine module
acceptance: fine.rs is split into focused submodules without behavior changes
Public playback API remains compatible for current callers
Focused projection tests still pass

projection-membership-remove-label-fallb.title: Remove remaining label-only selected membership fallback in playback
acceptance: selected_applies_to no longer treats label equality alone as sufficient
Selected membership applies only through coordinate/selection input evidence
Projection tests cover the no-coordinate label-only case

projection-membership-review-repair.title: Repair scoped membership projection review findings
acceptance: Public fine playback preserves candidate_set_root where available
Selected membership does not fall back to label-only matching for duplicate labels
No ploke-eval or ploke-records edits

projection-membership-scoped-keys.title: Preserve set-scoped candidate membership in browser and fine playback
acceptance: Browser/fine playback no longer treats bare membership_id as globally unique where set scope is available
No vector-index membership matching remains in touched playback path
No ploke-eval edits

records-rag-retry-context-cleanup.title: Replace RAG tool retry-context JSON with typed ToolRetryContext
acceptance: RAG retry-context callsites use ToolRetryContext instead of serde_json::json!
Temporary From<serde_json::Value> retry-context bridge is removed if no longer needed
No ploke-eval edits

records-tool-ui-contract-boundary.title: Type shared tool UI/error contract boundary for agent turns
acceptance: No ploke-eval edits
Any shared tool UI/error type is exposed through ploke_records::tool_contracts
No production serde_json::Value remains in the shared persisted tool error payload path being introduced

records-tool-ui-contract-review-repair.title: Repair typed tool UI/error contract review findings
acceptance: Serde deserialization initializes typed LLM error inspection/index consistently
Compatibility for existing ToolErrorCode wire spelling is preserved or explicitly typed
No production serde_json::Value remains in retry-context construction path introduced by this boundary

retainer-graph-ingestion-map.title: Locate exact graph ingestion source ranges and prior reports on demand
acceptance: Read-only: report exact files/ranges and avoid broad file dumps
Answer location questions for main thread and workers
Flag stale assumptions after five questions so the retainer can be refreshed

retainer-node-results-passive-shape.title: Locate passive shape for nodes results JSON
acceptance: Read-only: identify writer/type shape for nodes/*/results/*.json if current
Report whether ploke-records already owns the shape or what exact missing passive type is needed
Avoid reading generated run files wholesale

retainer-runtimeid-assertion-map.title: Map RuntimeId graph test failure to exact fix surface
acceptance: Read-only: identify exact failing assertion and RuntimeId API options
Report minimal allowed edit surface and verification command
Avoid broad file reads

acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check attempt_runner_results are ingested, operation evidence has source locators, and no authority drift
Write report only if findings are substantive

review-graph-membership-selected-scope.title: Review graph selected-membership fallback repair

Write report only if findings are substantive

review-graph-run-attempt-ingestion.title: Review graph run-attempt ingestion
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check operation identity joins, no authority drift, no filesystem/deserialization in graph build
Write report only if findings are substantive

acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement

Write report under docs/active/agents/ploke-tree-graph-ingestion/

review-graph-wave-boundaries.title: Review first graph-ingestion wave for boundary and allocation regressions
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check disjoint write surfaces, unnecessary clones, Value field-walking, and History authority drift
Write report under docs/active/agents/ploke-tree-graph-ingestion/

review-playback-fine-module-split.title: Review playback fine module split
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check split preserved public API and avoided behavior changes
Check fine.rs is now a small facade and submodules are cohesive

review-projection-membership-final.title: Final review scoped membership projection repair
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check public and browser playback preserve candidate_set_root and no label-only selected-membership fallback remains in playback
Write report only if findings are substantive

review-projection-membership-scoped-keys.title: Review scoped membership projection repair
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check set-scoped membership is preserved and no vector-index matching remains
Write report under docs/active/agents/ploke-tree-graph-ingestion/ only if findings are substantive

review-records-tool-ui-contract.title: Review typed tool UI/error contract boundary
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check dependency boundary, serde_json::Value removal, compatibility, and public API shape
Write report under docs/active/agents/ploke-tree-graph-ingestion/

review-records-tool-ui-final.title: Final review typed tool UI/error contract after RAG cleanup
acceptance: Report only unless explicitly reassigned to implement
Check no retry-context Value bridge/json! remains and direct serde still initializes typed payload
Write report only if findings are substantive

review-tool-transport-home-risks.title: Review risks for canonical passive tool transport home
acceptance: Read-only risk report covers API drift, dependency hygiene, serde compatibility, and no-copy invariant

store-load-attempt-results.title: Load nodes results attempt runner result files into RunRecordSet
acceptance: Store loader scans nodes/*/results/*.json as RunnerResultRecord without adding new passive DTOs
Attempt-scoped results remain separate from latest runner-result projections
No graph semantics or filesystem discovery outside store loading

store-load-run-attempt-metadata.title: Load runner request/result/invocation metadata into RunRecordSet
acceptance: Only store/loading code discovers run-file paths or deserializes run files
Loaded fields land in RunRecordSet or PassiveEvidence without graph semantics
No ploke-eval edits

esm-cli-live-admission-missing-coordinat.summary: Live deterministic cli_facing path calls validate_edit_surface_candidate without real parent runtime_id and target artifact_id in scope for EditSurfaceAdmission.
esm-cli-live-admission-missing-coordinat.proposed_unblock: Thread or derive the real operation coordinate from parent/runtime/artifact state before the production validation call; do not synthesize from prompt/request/TUI state.

esm-integration-cross-lane-invalid.summary: Backend/history grant-evidence join spans two owned edit lanes; board validation rejects a cross-lane implementation task.
esm-integration-cross-lane-invalid.proposed_unblock: Split into a History API task and an admission backend caller task with disjoint owned surfaces.

esm-surfacegrant-optional-authority-inva.summary: Grant authority is optional, so legacy broad/material-only paths still mint non-authority grants; check also erases grant authority.
esm-surfacegrant-optional-authority-inva.proposed_unblock: Replace optional authority with mandatory SurfaceGrant authority and preserve authority through Check/apply/History, or isolate material-only bounds behind a distinct non-authority adapter.

rag-retry-context-outside-surface.summary: Remaining retry-context json! callsites are in crates/ploke-tui/src/rag/tools.rs, outside the repair packet edit surface
rag-retry-context-outside-surface.proposed_unblock: Run a focused follow-up allowing crates/ploke-tui/src/rag/tools.rs plus tools/error.rs
